CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was found.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with coordinate lists (C), an organized presentation pattern is given (O), and an explicit origin/status field is attached (D) for the same current referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colors ('red'/'blue') and their coordinate sets in current records.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are attached separately to identified content entries, distinguishing identity from provenance/access status.

O.rationale: Text describes how contents are presented/organized (spatial grid orientation, node groupings and coordinate patterns).
